selection: Initialisms and coined or brand names whose default grapheme-to-phoneme reading is most likely wrong, chosen from terms that delivered narration actually speaks. Deliberately excluded: CamelCase product names (OpenShift, OpenShell, StatefulSet, NetworkPolicies) that Misaki already splits into ordinary words; common initialisms (GPU, TCP, SDK, API, CPU) it already spells out; and contested readings such as kubectl. Every entry is an expected pronunciation, not a measured one, until the acceptance listening pass confirms it. A digit-suffixed form needs its own entry: UBI does not fire inside UBI9.
